_comment: phone_osint — per-country reference DATA (RULE 3): extra messaging deep links and the ORIGINAL prefix allocation table. Nothing here is case data: these are public numbering-plan facts and public deep-link URL shapes. Editing a network's prefixes, or adding a country, is a data edit, not a code change.

messaging_extra._comment: Calling code -> {link name: URL template}. Placeholders: {digits} = E.164 digits without '+', {national} = domestic form with the trunk prefix (e.g. 0 + NSN), {nsn} = national significant number. Merged into the tool's messaging_links next to whatsapp/telegram/viber.

messaging_notes._comment: Calling code -> one-line reading note emitted with the extra links.

entries.84: Zalo resolves a phone to a profile only when the account allows search-by-phone; a 'not found' page is not evidence the number has no Zalo account, and a profile name is self-declared.

prefix_allocation._comment: Calling code -> numbering-plan allocation. `trunk` is the domestic trunk prefix used to build the written prefix (0 + leading NSN digits). `mobile` maps the network the prefix block was ORIGINALLY allocated to -> written prefixes. `mvno_host` names the host network of an MVNO where the MVNO rides one. `fixed_line` maps a written geographic area code -> area. `nsn_length` gives the expected NSN length per class. `ported_caveat` is emitted verbatim on every hit. Vietnam: mobile blocks after the 2018 11->10 digit conversion (MIC Decision 798/QD-BTTTT); fixed-line area codes after the 2017 conversion. The fixed_line list is the major areas only — an unlisted 02x code is reported as fixed-line with area unknown.

84.ported_caveat: Allocation is the network this prefix block was ORIGINALLY assigned to. Vietnam has run mobile number portability since 2021 (and MVNOs ride host networks), so the CURRENT carrier can differ — this is not a carrier determination and must not be reported as one.
84.fixed_line_caveat: A 02x area code names where the fixed-line number was allocated, not where the subscriber is; VoIP and hosted PBX services also issue geographic numbers.
